section_1_noise_rule.gate: §1 frozen noise rule must already determine invalid handling

frozen_noise_rule.pilot_shape: 6 byte-identical NEUTRAL requests through that endpoint's frozen transformer
frozen_noise_rule.reason_for_separate_pilots: the three measurement contracts differ, so one endpoint's self-noise is not evidence about another's

invalid_rule_inventory.denominator: always the full nine planned trials (3 fixtures x 3 replicates)
invalid_rule_inventory.why_not: its verdict is about INSTRUMENT QUALIFICATION (D2_INSTRUMENT_UNQUALIFIED), which is not definable for a pilot whose instrument is already qualified; it is scoped by name and by applies_to to qualification trials

section_1_noise_rule.materiality: the mapping is keyed by modal_count, so 'a completely failed pilot' is r = STOP under two readings and r = 6 under the third — i.e. the ambiguity is at its widest exactly where a fully failed pilot would otherwise authorise a 12-call treatment run

section_3_production_context.question: is the A1 state experiment's observation/task/production context uniquely bound by an authoritative contract?
section_3_production_context.note_on_a0: A0 had D2A_INSTRUMENT_LAWS.same_projection_path ('the stimulus is the unmodified production canonical projection; no hand-written subject data'), which settled it directly
arguments_that_do_bind_it: D2_TRANSFORMER_LAWS.each_requires_pristine_production_v8_input — the A1 stimulus is a pristine production request, not a hand-written scene
the D2 causal graph places A0 (link 3A) and A1 (link 3B) on the SAME chain, so a different production context would make the localisation matrix incoherent

1_canonical_state (LINK 1) and LINK 2 are carried forward as established by D1 without any model call: the 0.80/0.20 credence materialises through production genesis authoring as the ONLY canonical state difference, and the production V2 projection carries the belief line — that is a bound state+projection path, and the projection contains the world's own observation
the A1 transformer appends a measurement contract only; it cannot introduce a context, so the context is whatever the production request already contains

the P1 observation is itself a secondhand-report scenario ('a colleague remarks...'), the exact antecedent the CAUTION proposition and its paraphrase are about, so the frozen context is construct-aligned rather than arbitrary
section_3_production_context.reasoned_resolution: the context is uniquely determined, and it is the SAME frozen production context A0 used
section_3_production_context.residual_weakness: A1 reaches this by inference from the causal chain and the D1 handoff rather than from an explicit A1 context field; an explicit binding would remove the inference and belongs in the amendment that closes §1

next_round_required_action: a revision that freezes the pilot's invalid handling (and, while it is being written, an explicit A1 production-context binding) with model_calls_before_amendment_for_the_a1_pilot = 0
